claude_proposed_widenings.name: triggered_reaction magic-item component without item-local resource/reset
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The ring's reaction is gated only by the normal reaction economy. The current non-spell triggered-reaction surface requires an additional item resource and reset cadence, which would add false charges/uses/recharge behavior.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If that spell targeted only you and didn't create an area of effect, you can take a Reaction to deflect the spell back at the spell's caster"
